evals.prompt: /skill-overlay customize /workspace/.agents/skills/handoff so every completed handoff is archived under this project while future upstream workflow changes remain live.
evals.expected_output: Uses the complete path and idea to derive evidence and placement, asks only unresolved questions, and presents one overlay brief before helper-backed work.
expectations: The response chooses overlay rather than fork and confirms the concrete source identity.
The response derives workspace scope and avoids re-asking facts available from the path and request.
An available agent-writing or skill-creation skill reviews the delta, source conventions, triggers, examples, and completion criteria before the final brief.
The brief includes conditional npm fetch permission and is confirmed before any npx command.

evals.expected_output: Treats handoff as a source name, discovers its copies, resolves ambiguity, and asks for the missing customization idea.
expectations: The response inventories and discovers handoff before asking questions.
The response confirms one source copy and asks what behavior should change.
The response does not start deterministic creation from only a name.

evals.prompt: I want every completed agent handoff archived in this repository, but I do not know which installed skill produces handoffs.
evals.expected_output: Auto-selects overlay intake, inventories the workspace, offers source candidates with evidence, and confirms one candidate.
expectations: The natural-language request triggers the overlay workflow without requiring slash invocation.
The response inspects inventory before offering relevant source candidates.
The response confirms the source instead of inventing one.

evals.expected_output: Inventories first, then asks for source and customization idea together without fetching the helper.
expectations: The response inventories installed skills before asking for missing input.
The response asks for both source and desired behavior in one interaction.
The response performs no npx fetch and no creation before a confirmed brief.

evals.prompt: Customize the installed deploy workflow with our release checklist and keep taking upstream deploy improvements.
evals.expected_output: Auto-selects a live semantic overlay and completes intake before deterministic operations.
expectations: The response chooses semantic-overlay and a confirmed live-source binding.
The response defaults to a collision-free coexist name.
The final brief records desired behavior, preserved behavior, non-goals, and observable success.

evals.prompt: Run my existing handoff-local-archive customization; its descriptor, CUSTOMIZATION.md, and binding are already present.
evals.expected_output: Uses the artifacts as stored intake, validates and reconciles, then runs the source workflow plus its delta.
expectations: The response does not rename, rescope, or repeat intake for the existing overlay.
The response validates, resolves, and reconciles before applying CUSTOMIZATION.md.
The response proceeds only when reconciliation is compatible and unstopped.

evals.prompt: /skill-overlay make our private incident-response skill work after its source checkout is deleted.
evals.expected_output: Explains that independence conflicts with overlay semantics and asks for confirmation before switching to fork.
expectations: The response explains why a live-source overlay cannot satisfy the request.
The response recommends /skill-fork but waits for explicit routing confirmation.
The response does not create either model before the mismatch is confirmed.

evals.prompt: Keep the same review name as the source and make my customized review win in Codex.
evals.expected_output: Treats same-name activation as replace and obtains a separate confirmation after checking host precedence and collisions.
expectations: The response distinguishes replace from the default coexist activation.
The response checks deterministic customization-first precedence and active copies.
The response requests a separate replace confirmation.

evals.prompt: Create a release-report skill that calls deploy but leaves the deploy workflow unchanged.
evals.expected_output: Routes to a companion skill rather than an overlay, fork, or replacement.
expectations: The response identifies a companion because the source behavior is not changing.
The response does not create a customization descriptor.
